description_en: Queries whether an instance can be restored by using a cross-region backup set
description_zh: 该接口用于预检查某RDS实例是否可以用跨地域备份集进行跨地域恢复
kebab_example: aliyun rds check-create-ddr-db-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --engine MySQL --engine-version 5.6 --db-instance-class rds.mysql.s1.small --db-instance-storage 20 --restore-type 0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CheckCreateDdrDBInstance

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the destination instance. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 目的实例地域ID，可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The database engine of the destination instance. Valid values:

MySQL
SQLServer
PostgreSQL
parameters.help_zh:
目标数据库类型，取值：
MySQL
SQLServer
PostgreSQL
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en:
The major engine version of the destination instance. The value of this parameter varies based on the value of Engine.

Valid values when Engine is set to MySQL: 5.5, 5.6, 5.7, and 8.0
Valid values when Engine is set to SQLServer: 2008r2, 08r2_ent_ha, 2012, 2012_ent_ha, 2012_std_ha, 2012_web, 2014_std_ha, 2016_ent_ha, 2016_std_ha, 2016_web, 2017_std_ha, 2017_ent, 2019_std_ha, and 2019_ent
PostgreSQL: 10.0, 11.0, 12.0, 13.0, 14.0, and 15.0
parameters.help_zh:
目标数据库版本。根据Engine参数取值的不同，本参数取值如下：

MySQL：5.5/5.6/5.7/8.0
SQL Server：2008r2（高性能本地盘，已停售）/08r2_ent_ha（云盘版，已停售）/2012/2012_ent_ha/2012_std_ha/2012_web/2014_std_ha/2016_ent_ha/2016_std_ha/2016_web/2017_std_ha/2017_ent/2019_std_ha/2019_ent
PostgreSQL：10.0/11.0/12.0/13.0/14.0/15.0

SQL Server实例中`_ent`表示企业集群版、`_ent_ha`表示企业版、`_std_ha`表示标准版、`_web`表示Web版
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en: The instance type of the destination instance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html
parameters.name: db_instance_class

parameters.help_en: The storage capacity of the destination instance. Valid values: 5 to 2000. Unit: GB. You can increase the storage capacity in increments of 5 GB. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html
parameters.help_zh:
目的实例存储空间，取值： 5~2000。
每5 GB进行递增，单位：GB。详见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26312.html
parameters.name: db_instance_storage

parameters.help_en:
The method that is used to restore data. Valid values:

0: restores data from a backup set. If you set this parameter to 0, you must also specify the BackupSetId parameter.
1: restores data to a point in time. If you set this parameter to 1, you must also specify the RestoreTime, SourceRegion, and SourceDBInstanceName parameters.

Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh:
恢复方式，取值：

0（默认值）：基于备份集恢复，您还需要传入参数BackupSetId。
1：基于时间点恢复，您还需要传入参数RestoreTime、SourceRegion、SourceDBInstanceName
parameters.name: restore_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup set that is used for the restoration. You can call the DescribeCrossRegionBackups operation to query the backup set ID.

This parameter must be specified when the RestoreType parameter is set to 0
parameters.help_zh:
基于备份集恢复时，使用的备份集的ID。可以通过接口DescribeCrossRegionBackups查看备份集ID。
RestoreType=0时必传
parameters.name: backup_set_id

parameters.help_en:
The point in time to which you want to restore data. The point in time that you specify must be earlier than the current time. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC.

If you set RestoreType to 1, you must also specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 基于时间点恢复时，要恢复的时间节点，需要早于当前时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 RestoreType=1时必传
parameters.name: restore_time

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the source instance if you want to restore data to a point in time.

If you set RestoreType to 1, you must also specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
基于时间点恢复时，源地域的ID。
RestoreType=1时必传
parameters.name: source_region

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the source instance if you want to restore data to a point in time.

This parameter must be specified when the RestoreType parameter is set to 1
parameters.help_zh:
基于时间点恢复时，源实例的ID。
RestoreType=1时必传
parameters.name: source_db_instance_name

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute to query the resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

IsValid.description_en:
Indicates whether the data of the source instance can be restored across regions. Valid values:

true
false
IsValid.description_zh:
是否能创建容灾恢复实例，返回值：
true
false
